caption: The drawing depicts a single bird, which appears to be an eagle, in flight with its wings spread wide and its talons extended downward. The bird is predominantly colored in shades of brown and dark yellow, with detailed feather patterns visible throughout its wings and body. The eagle's beak is open, and the inside of the mouth is colored red. Its talons are black and sharply curved. The background is plain and uncolored, with an off-white or light beige tone. Near the lower right of the bird, the name "Beverly Chichester" is written in small text. There are no other objects or details on the canvas.
title: Carved Eagle
